subject.title: [Mac App] node.invoke system.run causes WebSocket disconnection on macOS

question: Should maintainers prioritize a signed current-main macOS app repro for `system.run` disconnects before assigning a repair lane?
rationale: The source path and reporter logs are credible, but the failure depends on live macOS app, WebSocket, and command timing behavior that cannot be proven from this checkout alone.

options.title: Run live macOS repro first
options.body: Use a signed current-main or latest-release macOS app with a paired Gateway to capture app and gateway logs for medium-duration `system.run` commands before implementation.

options.title: Wait for reporter diagnostics
options.body: Keep the issue open with `needs-live-repro` until the reporter or support can provide current app-side logs and a repeatable current-version failure.

options.title: Fold into broader flapping work
options.body: Only consolidate with the broader macOS node flapping report if live proof shows the same readiness or reconnect root cause.

recommendation.title: Run live macOS repro first
recommendation.body: Use a signed current-main or latest-release macOS app with a paired Gateway to capture app and gateway logs for medium-duration `system.run` commands before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest path history is on the macOS node runtime and shell executor implementation that owns the reported command execution behavior.
